typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFile_497 as string (),
	ExportPath as string (),
	ExportPath_497 as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_497 as string (),
	FTPFile as string (),
	FTPFile_497 as string (),
	FTPPath as string (),
	FTPPath_497 as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_INFO as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_COMPLETE as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_START as string ()
}

source(output(
		CODE_DT as timestamp,
		MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBERNUMBER,PCT.CODE_DT FROM PDS_OB_POST_CALLLIST_TERMINATION PCT 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON PCT.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID WHERE PCT.SENT_TO_WARMHEALTH = 0 AND PCT.SOURCE_CALLLIST_CD = \'499\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		FIRST_TERM_CODE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FIRST_TERM_CODE_DATE = CODE_DT,
		MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> FlatFileDestination
